commands.exit_code_evidence: Reviewer forwarded only r.output; underlying exit code was not retained. File text returned in full and outer functions.exec completed. Do not infer exit code 0.

initial_round.wall_clock_measurement: No consolidated stopwatch retained; local smoke commands took less than one second total. Reviewer used one bounded read and text replies, no waits or external calls.

behavior.observed: Three logical artifacts; red A-right→table→B-left; blue D-left; knock-triggered C reaction; separate speaker/listener/audience attention; one selected instant; screen/stage direction mapping.

independent_review.scope: Frozen Skill, three original prompt text-only exercises
independent_review.blind_inputs: Only frozen Skill, its necessary common contracts and three original prompts; no expect or author answers; no delegation or file writes.
independent_review.evidence_saving: Reviewer final answer saved by the sole report writer; Markdown hard-break whitespace normalized. Reviewer owns the review conclusion; author does not grant final acceptance.
independent_review.commit_verification: Reviewer received commit identity from coordinator. Coordinator independently checked HEAD and content digest in structural smoke.

acceptance.evidence: Short entrypoint, explicit I/O, scope/stop conditions and necessary handoff reference; no vendor/project defaults.
Three original cases committed before implementation; three actually executed by independent reviewer. Structure and behavior recorded separately.
Stable input refs/revisions, proposed IDs, provisional maturity, three downstream artifacts and explicit no-production claims.

rollback: Do not integrate the candidate if unwanted; retain this local branch/worktree. If already integrated, the integration owner may revert only the candidate commits through its own review process; no reset or source deletion.
stop_reason: Scoped Skill candidate and finite evidence complete. No further Skill creation, full production, merge to main, push, install or worktree cleanup.
